review.method: Contractor assistant visually inspected all ten fixed 960x803 checkpoint RGB tiles, before M3N development or holdout inference; projected cuboids corrected to visible 2D extents.
review.scope: Sparse selected checkpoints, not exhaustive labels or independent human certification. Keep small/dark/partly occluded visible objects. Physical approach states unchanged, relative to camera, not object self-motion.
review.selection: Intervals selected from timestamps/cadence/speed before RGB or model outputs; all source exposures disjoint from earlier study windows but from the same recording/domain. No candidate omission based on inference outputs.

review.omissionDisposition: All original candidates preserved. Visibility omissions are unscorable, not true negatives; frozen before inference. No physical motion or metric labels invented from image appearance.
